headline: REDDIT IS 28.9 PERCENT OF EVERYTHING CHATGPT CITES.  YOUTUBE IS 21.1 PERCENT OF WHAT GOOGLE'S AI CITES.  THE MACHINES ARE NOT ONE AUDIENCE
deck: A study across 22 US product categories found the assistants do not read the same internet.  Reddit is ChatGPT's single biggest source, at 28.9 percent of every citation it makes.  Google's AI answers lean on video and social instead, with YouTube first at 21.1 percent and Facebook second at 17.  Everyone has spent this year being told to make video so the machines quote you.  Which machine turns out to matter more than the video does.
tldr: Reddit is 28.9 percent of every citation ChatGPT makes, while YouTube is 21.1 percent of Google's AI citations and Facebook is second at 17, across a 22-category US study.  Ask your ten most valuable buying questions in both ChatGPT and Google AI Mode this week, log which sources each cites for your category, and split your next brief so the video serves one side and a genuine forum presence serves the other.

The IAB raised its US ad spend growth estimate for this year from 9.5 percent to 12.3 percent and credits part of the rise to brands spending more on awareness work to improve how AI answers describe them, with 61 percent of 2,600 US shoppers surveyed by Dept having used an AI assistant for shopping in the past three months.  Add a slide to your next budget request tracking your share of mentions in AI answers next to your share of search, monthly from now, so you own the baseline before the standards arrive.

Howl ran up delinquent invoices of 20,000 to 900,000 dollars stretching back eight months, still owes one publisher around 60,000, and quietly sold its creator business to Taboola's Connexity in August, whose first email to acquired creators was about fixing payments.  Write down who holds the money between sale and payout on every creator and affiliate contract you run, and move the ones your finance team would not extend credit to onto direct payment.

Sonos lost at least 100 million dollars of revenue in the six months after its 2024 app update and has built its first repositioning since then around the system that broke, made entirely in house with no agency, as third-quarter revenue rose 9 percent to 375 million.  Ask the team that owns your biggest customer complaint whether it is genuinely fixed and how you would prove it in thirty seconds, then build the next campaign on whichever answer you get.

Nintendo's pre-recorded Direct peaked above 3.7 million concurrent viewers on 11 September with more than 2,200 channels carrying it, while BlizzCon's two-day convention peaked at 1.76 million across more than 1,400 channels and 8.8 million hours watched.  Demand peak concurrents, average concurrents, hours watched and total airtime in one table on your next live sponsorship proposal, and price the official broadcast separately from the co-stream network.

Sydney Sweeney holds equity in Novig and says she was in the creative conversations from the start, and the backlash to its first national campaign landed on her exactly as it landed on Kendall Jenner, Mary J. Blige, Brooke Shields and Danica Patrick for work they did not author.  Draft the statement naming your brand as the author of the idea before the campaign ships, and put it in the same approval pack as the creative.

TheOutdoorGearReview has 768,000 subscribers, 234 million lifetime views, a 105,000-view median across his last fifteen uploads and 411,273 on an unsponsored bivvy tent video, and by our count the premium brands he reviews all land below his median while his no-product storm films sit around 144,500.  If you sell tents, packs, sleep systems or camp stoves, send him your hardest-to-believe product this week with no brief and no conditions, budgeted as seeding rather than media.
